# Tickbox Test Tables

> [!summary]
> Tables for trying [[Tickbox]]: click a ☐ to tick it, click a ☑ to untick it. Works in Live Preview and Reading view.

> [!tip] How to use
> - **Click or tap** a box to flip it. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
> - **Ctrl+Shift+Enter** flips the box nearest the cursor while you edit a cell.
> - **Type `[]`** inside a cell to get a new ☐.

## Single boxes

| Task     | Done |
| -------- | ---- |
| Buy milk | ☐    |
| Call mum | ☑    |
| Pay rent | ☐    |

## Several boxes per cell

| Habit | Mon Tue Wed Thu |
| ----- | --------------- |
| Gym   | ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐         |
| Read  | ☑ ☐ ☑ ☐         |

## Several boxes per row

| Room    | Clean | Tidy | Hoover |
| ------- | ----- | ---- | ------ |
| Kitchen | ☐     | ☑    | ☐      |
| Bedroom | ☑     | ☐    | ☐      |

## Mixed text and boxes

| Trip | Packing list                       |
| ---- | ---------------------------------- |
| Oslo | ☐ passport, ☐ charger, ☑ tickets   |
| Shop | eggs ☐ and **bread** ☑, `code ☐` ☐ |

## Box at the start and end of a cell

| Start   | End        | Both       |
| ------- | ---------- | ---------- |
| ☐ first | last ☐     | ☐ middle ☑ |
| ☑ done  | not yet ☐  | ☑ x ☐      |

## Inside a callout

> [!note] A table in a callout
> | Plant    | Watered |
> | -------- | ------- |
> | Basil    | ☐       |
> | Rosemary | ☑       |
